caption_L1: This area graph is called Total neodymium oxide demand worldwide excluding China from 2009 to 2025 (in metric tons). The x-axis plots Year while the y-axis plots Demand in metric tons.
caption_L2L3: The worldwide demand for neodymium oxide doubled in five years, starting at 10,000 in 2015 and increasing to 20,000 in 2020. The graph indicates the increase in demand has slowed since 2020 but it is still on the rise.
